index.meaning: 悬挂式金合欢木告示牌
墙上的悬挂式金合欢木告示牌
墙上的金合欢木告示牌

medium.sentence: The player collects wood to build a small house.
medium.translation: 玩家收集木材，准备建一座小房子。

hard.sentence: A new player joins our game and wants to help build a house. I show them how to make the walls while my friend works on the roof.
hard.translation: 一位新玩家加入我们的游戏，想帮忙建房子。我教这位玩家怎样砌墙，朋友则负责搭屋顶。

medium.sentence: Our world has a forest, a river, and a village.
medium.translation: 我们的世界里有森林、河流和村庄。

hard.sentence: We start a new world and find a river between two hills. We build a bridge across it so our friends can visit the houses on both sides.
hard.translation: 我们创建了一个新世界，发现两座山之间有一条河。我们在河上建桥，让朋友们能去两岸的房子串门。

medium.sentence: I place one more block to fill the hole in the wall.
medium.translation: 我再放一块方块，填上墙上的洞。

hard.sentence: One block is missing from the pattern on our floor, but the others are blue and white. I look at the row above to choose the right color.
hard.translation: 地板上的图案缺了一个方块，其余方块都是蓝色和白色的。我看看上面一排，选出该用的颜色。

medium.sentence: I pick up the item and put it in my inventory.
medium.translation: 我捡起那件物品，把它放进物品栏。

hard.sentence: My friend drops an item beside the chest and walks away. I pick it up, see that it is a shovel, and bring it to the farm.
hard.translation: 朋友在箱子旁丢下一件物品后走开了。我把它捡起来，发现是一把铲子，就把它带到农场。

medium.sentence: An axe is a tool I use to chop wood.
medium.translation: 斧头是我用来砍木头的工具。

hard.sentence: I need a tool to clear dirt from our new path. My friend offers an axe, but I choose a shovel because it is better for digging dirt.
hard.translation: 我需要一件工具，把新路上的泥土清掉。朋友递来斧头，但我选了铲子，因为它更适合挖泥土。

medium.sentence: A sheep is a mob that can move around the world.
medium.translation: 羊是一种能在世界里四处走动的生物。

hard.sentence: I see a mob moving behind the fence, but I cannot see its head. When it steps into the light, its white wool shows me it is a sheep.
hard.translation: 我看见围栏后有一只生物在动，却看不到它的头。它走到亮处后，我从白色的羊毛认出那是一只羊。

medium.sentence: Our house has two beds and a window facing the garden.
medium.translation: 我们的房子里有两张床，还有一扇朝向花园的窗户。

hard.sentence: Our house has room for two beds, but another friend wants to stay. We make one room bigger so everyone has a place to sleep.
hard.translation: 我们的房子放得下两张床，可又有一位朋友想住下。我们把一个房间扩大，让每个人都有睡觉的地方。

medium.sentence: I place torches in the cave so I can see the path.
medium.translation: 我在洞穴里放上火把，好看清道路。

hard.sentence: The cave has two tunnels that look almost the same. We put a sign beside the tunnel we explore first, so we will know which one to try next.
hard.translation: 洞穴里有两条看起来很像的通道。我们在先探索的那条旁边放上告示牌，这样就知道接下来该走哪条了。

medium.sentence: We follow the path through the village to find a farmer.
medium.translation: 我们沿着村里的小路走，寻找一位农民。

hard.sentence: The village has several small houses, and I forget which one is near the farm. I follow the path past the well until I see the crops.
hard.translation: 村里有好几座小房子，我忘了哪座靠近农场。我沿着小路经过水井，一直走到能看见作物的地方。

medium.sentence: We grow wheat and carrots on the farm beside our house.
medium.translation: 我们在房子旁的农场里种小麦和胡萝卜。

hard.sentence: Our farm has wheat on one side and carrots on the other. I put a sign beside each row so a new friend knows where to plant more.
hard.translation: 我们的农场一边种小麦，另一边种胡萝卜。我在每一行旁放上告示牌，让新来的朋友知道该在哪里接着种。

medium.sentence: The map shows the path to the hidden valley.
medium.translation: 地图标出了通往隐蔽山谷的小路。

hard.sentence: I unfold the map on the table and look for the river. We mark our house with a red cross so we can find it after a long trip.
hard.translation: 我把地图在桌上摊开，寻找那条河。我们在房子位置画了一个红叉，这样走远路回来也能找到家。

medium.sentence: I keep my tools in the chest by the door.
medium.translation: 我把工具放在门边的箱子里。

hard.sentence: We open the old chest in the cellar and find a shiny apple inside. My friend says a farmer must have left it there long ago.
hard.translation: 我们打开地窖里的旧箱子，发现里面有一个亮晶晶的苹果。朋友说一定是农夫很久以前留下的。

medium.sentence: Please close the door so the sheep stay inside.
medium.translation: 请把门关好，别让羊跑出去。

hard.sentence: Someone is knocking on our door early in the morning. I open it slowly and see my neighbor holding a basket of fresh bread.
hard.translation: 一大早有人在敲门。我慢慢打开门，看见邻居提着一篮新鲜面包。

medium.sentence: I look out of the window to check the weather.
medium.translation: 我望向窗外看看天气。

hard.sentence: The window in my room faces the rising sun. Every morning the light wakes me up before my alarm clock rings.
hard.translation: 我房间的窗户朝着日出方向。每天早晨，阳光总在闹钟响之前把我叫醒。

medium.sentence: Climb the ladder to fix the roof of the house.
medium.translation: 爬上梯子去修房子的屋顶。

hard.sentence: The ladder against the big tree helps us reach the treehouse. We carry the planks up one by one and build a small floor first.
hard.translation: 靠在大树上的梯子帮我们爬上树屋。我们把木板一块块搬上去，先搭好一个小地板。

medium.sentence: The furnace turns the metal into a shiny bar.
medium.translation: 熔炉把金属烧成发亮的金属条。

hard.sentence: We put the iron ore into the furnace before dinner. When the fire goes out, the metal is ready and we make a new pickaxe together.
hard.translation: 晚饭前我们把铁矿放进熔炉。火熄灭时，金属就炼好了，我们一起做了一把新镐子。

medium.sentence: The farm grows wheat, carrots, and potatoes.
medium.translation: 农场种着小麦、胡萝卜和土豆。

hard.sentence: Grandpa's farm is busy in autumn. We help him pick the vegetables and carry them to the market in a wooden cart.
hard.translation: 秋天，爷爷的农场很忙。我们帮他收蔬菜，用木推车运到集市去。

medium.sentence: He draws a map of our whole island.
medium.translation: 他画了一张整个岛的地图。

hard.sentence: Our hand-drawn map hangs by the front door. Every new place we explore gets a small drawing and a funny name of its own.
hard.translation: 我们手绘的地图挂在前门旁。每探索一个新地方，我们都会画上一个小图，再给它起个有趣的名字。

medium.sentence: The water in the lake is cool and clear.
medium.translation: 湖里的水又凉又清。

hard.sentence: We follow the water down the hill and find where the stream meets the sea. Small fish swim past our boots in the shallow part.
hard.translation: 我们沿着水往山下走，发现小溪在这里汇入大海。小鱼从我们脚边的浅水里游过。

medium.sentence: We sit around the fire and tell stories at night.
medium.translation: 夜里我们围着火堆讲故事。

hard.sentence: The campfire keeps wild animals away in the dark. We take turns adding small sticks so the fire stays strong until morning.
hard.translation: 篝火在黑夜中挡开了野兽。我们轮流添小树枝，让火一直烧到天亮。

medium.sentence: The lantern gives us light in the dark cave.
medium.translation: 灯笼在黑暗的洞穴里给我们光亮。

hard.sentence: Light from the window falls on my drawing book. I can see every color clearly and finish my picture of the village.
hard.translation: 窗外的光照在我的画本上。每种颜色都看得很清楚，我画完了村庄的图画。

medium.sentence: We cook food over the fire before it gets dark.
medium.translation: 天黑前我们在火上做吃的。

hard.sentence: Good food helps us stay strong on a long trip. We pack bread, apples, and cheese in the bag before we leave home.
hard.translation: 好食物让我们在长途旅行中保持有力气。出发前我们把面包、苹果和奶酪装进背包。

medium.sentence: A good tool makes the work fast and easy.
medium.translation: 一件好工具让活儿又快又轻松。

hard.sentence: Every tool in the shed has its own job. The hammer pulls nails, and the saw cuts the wood into the right sizes.
hard.translation: 棚里每件工具都有自己的任务。锤子拔钉子，锯子把木头锯成合适的尺寸。

medium.sentence: The training ground teaches him how to hold the weapon.
medium.translation: 训练场教他怎么握武器。

hard.sentence: In the game, each weapon has its own power and speed. We try them all and choose the one that feels right for us.
hard.translation: 游戏里每种武器都有自己的力量和速度。我们挨个试用，选出最趁手的那把。

medium.sentence: The knight puts on his armor before the trip.
medium.translation: 骑士出发前穿上了盔甲。

hard.sentence: The armor is heavy at first, but it keeps him safe on the long road. After a few days, he walks as fast as before.
hard.translation: 盔甲起初很沉，但它一路保护着他的安全。过了几天，他又能走得和从前一样快了。

medium.sentence: My friend helps me build the treehouse.
medium.translation: 朋友帮我建树屋。

hard.sentence: A good friend shares the last piece of bread on a hard day. We promise to meet at the big tree every Saturday morning.
hard.translation: 好朋友会在艰难的日子里分你最后一块面包。我们约好每周六早上在大树下见面。

medium.sentence: The map leads us to a great adventure.
medium.translation: 这张地图带我们开始一场大冒险。

hard.sentence: Our adventure starts at the old bridge outside town. We carry rope, food, and a lamp, and write down everything we see in a small book.
hard.translation: 我们的冒险从镇外的老桥开始。我们带着绳子、食物和一盏灯，把看到的一切记在小本子里。

medium.sentence: I put the new pickaxe into my inventory.
medium.translation: 我把新镐子放进物品栏。

hard.sentence: The inventory in the game holds everything we collect. We sort the items and drop the ones we do not need to make space.
hard.translation: 游戏里的物品栏装着我们收集的所有东西。我们把物品分类，丢掉不需要的来腾出空间。

medium.sentence: Choose the block from the hotbar and place it.
medium.translation: 从快捷栏选中方块，然后放下去。

hard.sentence: I keep my favorite tools on the hotbar so I can find them fast. When a zombie comes, I switch to the sword in one click.
hard.translation: 我把最常用的工具放在快捷栏，一眼就能找到。僵尸一来，我一下就能切到剑。

medium.sentence: Eating bread brings his health back quickly.
medium.translation: 吃面包让他的生命值很快恢复。

hard.sentence: In the game, falling from a high place costs some health. We build soft sand under the tower to keep our heroes safe.
hard.translation: 游戏里从高处摔下会掉生命值。我们在塔下铺了软软的沙子保护角色。

medium.sentence: Running all day makes his hunger bar drop.
medium.translation: 跑了一整天，他的饥饿值降下来了。

hard.sentence: The hunger bar drops when we sprint and jump. We cook a steak on the fire and eat it to fill the bar again.
hard.translation: 奔跑跳跃会让饥饿值下降。我们在火上烤了一块牛排吃掉，把饥饿值补满。

medium.sentence: Mining ores gives him a lot of experience.
medium.translation: 挖矿让他获得很多经验。

hard.sentence: Every task we finish gives us experience points. When we collect enough, the level-up sound rings and a new number appears.
hard.translation: 每完成一个任务都会得到经验值。攒够以后，升级的音效响起，新的数字出现了。

medium.sentence: She reaches level five after the big quest.
medium.translation: 完成大任务后她到了五级。

hard.sentence: The new level unlocks a magic door in the mountain. We walk through it and find a room full of colorful gems.
hard.translation: 新的等级解锁了山里的魔法门。我们走进去，发现满屋都是彩色宝石。

medium.sentence: We build a small house at the spawn point.
medium.translation: 我们在出生点建了一座小房子。

hard.sentence: The spawn point is where every game begins. We put a bed and a chest there, so we never get lost on the first night.
hard.translation: 出生点是每局游戏开始的地方。我们在那里放了床和箱子，这样第一晚就不会迷路。

medium.sentence: We build the fence during the day and rest at night.
medium.translation: 我们白天建栅栏，晚上休息。

hard.sentence: The day in the game is only ten minutes long. We hurry to finish the roof before the sun goes down.
hard.translation: 游戏里的一天只有十分钟。我们赶在太阳下山前把屋顶盖好。

medium.sentence: At night we close the door and light the lamp.
medium.translation: 夜里我们关好门，点上灯。

hard.sentence: The forest sounds different at night. We hear soft steps outside the window and hold our breath until the sound fades away.
hard.translation: 夜里的森林声音不一样。我们听见窗外轻轻的脚步声，屏住呼吸直到声音远去。

medium.sentence: The sun rises and the farm wakes up.
medium.translation: 太阳升起，农场醒了。

hard.sentence: We plant the seeds when the sun is high in the sky. By the time it sets, small green leaves are already showing.
hard.translation: 太阳高高挂起时我们播下种子。到太阳落山时，小绿叶已经冒出来了。

medium.sentence: The moon lights the path back to the house.
medium.translation: 月亮照亮了回家的路。

hard.sentence: The moon is full tonight, so the whole valley is bright. We sit on the hill and count the stars around it.
hard.translation: 今晚月圆，整个山谷都被照亮了。我们坐在山坡上，数着月亮周围的星星。

medium.sentence: The rain helps the crops grow tall.
medium.translation: 雨水帮庄稼长高。

hard.sentence: The rain starts while we are on the bridge. We run home, laughing, and watch the drops race down the window.
hard.translation: 我们在桥上时下起了雨。我们笑着跑回家，看雨点在窗上赛跑。

medium.sentence: The snow covers the village like a white blanket.
medium.translation: 雪像白毯子一样盖住村庄。

hard.sentence: We build a snowman by the gate and give him a carrot nose. In the morning, the sun paints the snow pink and gold.
hard.translation: 我们在大门口堆了个雪人，给它安上胡萝卜鼻子。早晨，太阳把雪地染成了粉色和金色。

medium.sentence: Birds sing in the tree outside my window.
medium.translation: 鸟儿在我窗外的树上唱歌。

hard.sentence: The old tree by the river is our meeting place. We hang a wooden welcome sign on it for all our friends.
hard.translation: 河边那棵老树是我们的集合点。我们在上面挂了一块木牌欢迎所有朋友。

medium.sentence: She picks a flower for her mom.
medium.translation: 她摘了一朵花送给妈妈。

hard.sentence: Bees fly from flower to flower in the garden. We count how many colors we can find before it is time for lunch.
hard.translation: 蜜蜂在花园里从一朵花飞到另一朵花。我们赶在午饭前数一数能找到多少种颜色。

medium.sentence: Each animal on the farm has a name.
medium.translation: 农场里每只动物都有名字。

hard.sentence: We follow the small animal tracks in the snow. At the end of the trail, we find a rabbit family under a big pine tree.
hard.translation: 我们跟着雪地里的小小动物脚印走。小路的尽头，一棵大松树下住着兔子一家。

medium.sentence: The monster hides under the old bridge.
medium.translation: 怪物躲在老桥下面。

hard.sentence: In the story, the monster is not scary at all. It only wants someone to share its warm soup on a cold night.
hard.translation: 在故事里，怪物一点也不吓人。它只是想在冷夜里有人一起喝热汤。

medium.sentence: Our team works together to beat the boss.
medium.translation: 我们团队合作打败了首领。

hard.sentence: The boss has three strong attacks, and we learn the pattern one by one. When it falls, golden lights dance around our team.
hard.translation: 首领有三招厉害的攻击，我们一点点学会了规律。它倒下时，金色的光在我们队伍周围飞舞。

medium.sentence: The treasure map leads us to the old tower.
medium.translation: 藏宝图把我们带到老塔。

hard.sentence: We dig under the marked tree and hear a clink. The small chest holds gold coins and a note from a long-lost traveler.
hard.translation: 我们在做了记号的树下挖起来，听到叮的一声。小箱子里装着金币和一张迷路旅人留下的字条。

cards.translation: 一扇神奇的紫色传送门。

easy.translation: 一扇神奇的紫色传送门。

medium.sentence: The portal takes us to a brand-new world.
medium.translation: 传送门带我们来到全新的世界。

hard.sentence: We build the portal with twelve blocks and light it up. On the other side, floating islands drift in a purple sky.
hard.translation: 我们用十二个方块搭好传送门并点亮它。门的另一边，浮空岛在紫色天空里漂浮。

medium.sentence: We ride the cart down into the mine.
medium.translation: 我们坐着矿车下到矿井里。

hard.sentence: Torches line the walls of the mine, and every turn brings a new sound. We keep our lanterns close and mark the way with chalk.
hard.translation: 矿井墙壁上点着火把，每个拐角都有新的声音。我们提着灯，用粉笔在路上做记号。

medium.sentence: The wall of the cave is full of iron ore.
medium.translation: 洞穴的墙壁上满是铁矿。

hard.sentence: We find a vein of gold ore behind the waterfall. It takes two days to dig it out carefully without breaking a single piece.
hard.translation: 我们在瀑布后面发现一条金矿矿脉。我们花了两天时间小心挖掘，一块都没弄碎。

medium.sentence: The gem glows softly in her hand.
medium.translation: 宝石在她手里微微发光。

hard.sentence: The smallest gem in the shop is the rarest one. The old seller says it was found at the top of the snowy mountain.
hard.translation: 店里最小的宝石是最稀有的。老店主说它是在雪山山顶发现的。

medium.sentence: We chop wood for the fire before winter.
medium.translation: 入冬前我们砍柴备着生火。

hard.sentence: Different trees give different wood for building. We choose the dark one for the floor and the light one for the walls.
hard.translation: 不同的树能提供不同的木材。我们选深色的做地板，浅色的做墙。

medium.sentence: The bridge is made of strong stone.
medium.translation: 这座桥由坚固的石头建成。

hard.sentence: We skip stones across the quiet lake after school. The best one jumps five times before it sinks into the water.
hard.translation: 放学后我们在安静的湖面上打水漂。最好的那颗跳了五下才沉进水里。

medium.sentence: The gate is made of heavy metal.
medium.translation: 大门由沉重的金属做成。

hard.sentence: The forge heats the metal until it turns orange. Then the smith shapes it into a horseshoe with quick, strong hits.
hard.translation: 炉火把金属烧得发橙。铁匠快速有力地敲打，把它打成马蹄铁。

medium.sentence: The village house has a red roof and a garden.
medium.translation: 村庄房屋有红屋顶和一个小花园。

hard.sentence: Every village house in the valley looks a little different. Ours has a wide porch where we watch the sun set together.
hard.translation: 山谷里的村庄房屋各不相同。我们家的门廊很宽，大家一起在那里看日落。

medium.sentence: The farmer plants corn in the big field.
medium.translation: 农民在大田里种玉米。

hard.sentence: The field changes color with the seasons. In autumn, the golden wheat moves like waves when the wind blows.
hard.translation: 田野随季节变换颜色。秋天，风吹过，金色的麦子像波浪一样起伏。

medium.sentence: The minecart races along the iron rails.
medium.translation: 矿车沿铁轨飞驰。

hard.sentence: We build a long rail loop for the minecart around the mountain. The tunnel part is dark, so we place lamps every few blocks.
hard.translation: 我们绕着山修了一条长长的矿车环形轨道。隧道段很暗，所以每隔几格就放一盏灯。

medium.sentence: The boat floats down the slow river.
medium.translation: 小船在缓缓的河上漂流。

hard.sentence: We paddle the boat to the middle of the lake and stop. Under us, fish swim between the water plants like little shadows.
hard.translation: 我们把船划到湖中央停下。船下，鱼儿像小影子一样在水草间穿行。

medium.sentence: In survival mode, we must find food every day.
medium.translation: 在生存模式里，我们每天都要找食物。

hard.sentence: Survival mode is all about planning ahead. We store wood, cook meals, and build strong walls before the first night falls.
hard.translation: 生存模式的关键是提前计划。我们存好木材、做好饭、在第一夜来临前建好结实的墙。

medium.sentence: Creative mode gives us every block for free.
medium.translation: 创造模式免费给我们所有方块。

hard.sentence: In creative mode, we build a giant castle with rainbow towers. Nothing can hurt us, so our ideas can fly as high as they want.
hard.translation: 在创造模式里，我们建起带彩虹塔楼的巨型城堡。没有任何危险，想法可以飞多高就飞多高。

medium.sentence: Adventure mode lets us explore the map maker's world.
medium.translation: 冒险模式让我们探索地图作者的世界。

hard.sentence: In adventure mode, we follow the story the builder wrote for us. Each door opens only after we solve its little puzzle.
hard.translation: 在冒险模式里，我们沿着建造者写好的故事前进。每扇门都要解开小谜题才会打开。

medium.sentence: Spectator mode lets us fly through walls safely.
medium.translation: 旁观模式让我们安全地穿墙飞行。

hard.sentence: In spectator mode, we drift over the whole city without being seen. It feels like being a quiet bird in the clouds.
hard.translation: 在旁观模式里，我们悄悄飘过整座城市，谁也看不见。就像云里的安静小鸟。

medium.sentence: In peaceful mode, no monsters come out at night.
medium.translation: 在和平模式里，晚上不会有怪物出现。

hard.sentence: We switch to peaceful mode and explore the deep cave calmly. With no danger around, we can enjoy the glowing crystals in peace.
hard.translation: 我们切换到和平模式，安心探索深深的洞穴。周围没有危险，可以静静欣赏发光的水晶。

medium.sentence: Easy mode is a good start for new players.
medium.translation: 简单模式对新玩家很友好。

hard.sentence: My little sister plays in easy mode while she learns the controls. Soon she says she is ready for a bigger challenge.
hard.translation: 妹妹学操作的时候玩简单模式。很快她就说自己准备好迎接更大的挑战了。

medium.sentence: Normal mode gives us both fun and challenge.
medium.translation: 正常模式既有乐趣也有挑战。

hard.sentence: Normal mode is just right for our team. Monsters appear at night, but we have built enough torches to keep them away.
hard.translation: 正常模式对我们的队伍刚刚好。夜里会有怪物，但我们插的火把足够把它们挡在外面。

medium.sentence: Hard mode tests everything we have learned.
medium.translation: 困难模式考验我们学到的一切。

hard.sentence: In hard mode, the nights are long and the food runs out fast. We win by sharing jobs and watching out for each other.
hard.translation: 困难模式里黑夜漫长，食物消耗得很快。我们靠分工合作、互相照应取得了胜利。

medium.sentence: Singleplayer lets her build at her own speed.
medium.translation: 单人游戏让她按自己的节奏建造。

hard.sentence: In singleplayer, every choice is ours to make. We keep a journal of our little world and read it like a storybook.
hard.translation: 单人游戏里每个决定都由自己做。我们给小世界写日记，读起来像一本故事书。

medium.sentence: Multiplayer means playing with friends far away.
medium.translation: 多人游戏就是和远方的朋友一起玩。

hard.sentence: Multiplayer nights are the best part of the week. Four of us build one big farm, and every friend takes care of their own row.
hard.translation: 多人游戏之夜是一周里最棒的时光。我们四个人共建一个大农场，每人照顾自己那一排。

cards.translation: 一个友好的游戏服务器。

easy.translation: 一个友好的游戏服务器。

medium.sentence: Our server can hold up to twenty players.
medium.translation: 我们的服务器最多能容纳二十名玩家。

hard.sentence: The server keeps the whole world safe while we are away. Our builds stay just as we left them until we come back.
hard.translation: 服务器在我们离开时守护着整个世界。我们的建筑会保持原样，等我们回来。

medium.sentence: The same world seed makes the same world every time.
medium.translation: 相同的世界种子每次都会生成相同的世界。

hard.sentence: We share our favorite world seed with the class. Everyone's world looks the same, but each of us builds a totally different home.
hard.translation: 我们把最喜欢的世界种子分享给全班。每个人的世界一模一样，但建出来的家完全不同。

medium.sentence: The coordinates show exactly where we stand.
medium.translation: 坐标精确显示我们所在的位置。

hard.sentence: We write down the coordinates of every cool place we find. Without them, the secret cave would be lost in the huge world.
hard.translation: 我们记下每个酷地方所在的坐标。没有它们，秘密洞穴就会消失在茫茫世界里。

medium.sentence: We can change the difficulty in the settings.
medium.translation: 我们可以在设置里更改难度。

hard.sentence: The right difficulty makes the game fun, not stressful. We try each one and talk about how the night feels in every mode.
hard.translation: 合适的难度让游戏有趣而不紧张。我们挨个尝试，聊聊每种模式下夜晚的不同感受。

medium.sentence: One game rule keeps the rain away forever.
medium.translation: 有一条游戏规则能让雨永远停下。

hard.sentence: The game rules let the teacher build a quiet class world. No monsters, no hunger, only building and teamwork.
hard.translation: 游戏规则让老师搭出一个安静的课堂世界。没有怪物，没有饥饿，只有建造和合作。

medium.sentence: The recipe book shows how to craft each tool.
medium.translation: 配方书展示每种工具的合成方法。

hard.sentence: Grandma's real recipe book smells like cinnamon. The game one smells like nothing, but it never gets flour on the pages.
hard.translation: 奶奶的配方书有肉桂的香味。游戏里的那本没有味道，但页面上永远不会沾面粉。

medium.sentence: We learn a crafting recipe for shiny armor.
medium.translation: 我们学会了闪亮盔甲的合成配方。

hard.sentence: Each crafting recipe needs the right shapes on the grid. We copy the pattern carefully and get a brand-new shield.
hard.translation: 每个合成配方都需要在格子上摆对形状。我们仔细照着图案摆放，做出了一面崭新的盾牌。

medium.sentence: Finishing the farm unlocks a new advancement.
medium.translation: 建好农场解锁了新进度。

hard.sentence: The advancement list is like a treasure map of the whole game. We read it at breakfast and pick our next big goal.
hard.translation: 进度列表就像整个游戏的藏宝图。我们边吃早餐边看，挑好下一个大目标。

medium.sentence: The quest sends us to the snowy mountain peak.
medium.translation: 任务把我们送到雪山之顶。

hard.sentence: The final quest asks us to bring three rare items to the old wizard. We split up, search fast, and meet again at sunset.
hard.translation: 最后的任务要我们把三件稀有物品带给老巫师。我们分头行动、快速搜寻，日落时再碰头。

medium.sentence: Each heart in the corner means part of our health.
medium.translation: 角落里每颗心代表一部分生命值。

hard.sentence: When the last heart turns gray, the game is over. We learn to carry cooked food so our hearts stay full and red.
hard.translation: 当最后一颗心变灰，游戏就结束了。我们学会随身带熟食，让心一直红红的满满的。

medium.sentence: The hunger bar shakes when we are very hungry.
medium.translation: 非常饿的时候，饥饿条会抖动。

hard.sentence: We watch the hunger bar during the long race across the desert. A quick snack at the halfway point keeps us running strong.
hard.translation: 横穿沙漠的长跑中我们盯着饥饿条。半路快点小吃一把，就能继续有力气跑。

medium.sentence: The armor bar fills up when we put on iron armor.
medium.translation: 穿上铁甲后护甲条就满了。

hard.sentence: The armor bar appears above the hunger bar once we gear up. It slowly breaks during the fight, so we carry spare pieces.
hard.translation: 装备好以后，护甲条出现在饥饿条上方。战斗中它会慢慢损坏，所以我们带着备用件。

medium.sentence: The air bubbles shrink while we swim underwater.
medium.translation: 在水下游泳时氧气泡会变小。

hard.sentence: We dive to the sunken ship and watch the last air bubble pop. Just in time, we swim up and take a huge breath of air.
hard.translation: 我们潜到沉船上，看着最后一个氧气泡破掉。我们及时游上水面，深深吸了一大口气。

medium.sentence: The XP orb flies to us when we win a fight.
medium.translation: 打赢后经验球朝我们飞来。

hard.sentence: The little XP orbs make a bell sound when they reach us. We collect them all and level up twice in one evening.
hard.translation: 小经验球到达时会有铃铛声。我们全部收下，一晚上升了两级。

medium.sentence: The status effect makes him jump extra high.
medium.translation: 状态效果让他跳得特别高。

hard.sentence: A green icon shows our status effect at the top of the screen. We read what it does before we drink any strange potion.
hard.translation: 屏幕上方的绿色图标显示我们的状态效果。喝任何奇怪的药水前，我们先弄清它的作用。

medium.sentence: The potion effect lets us see in the dark.
medium.translation: 药水效果让我们在黑暗中也能看见。

hard.sentence: The night-vision potion effect turns the dark cave bright blue. We follow the map to the treasure room before it wears off.
hard.translation: 夜视药水效果让黑暗的洞穴变成亮蓝色。趁效果没消失，我们跟着地图找到了宝藏室。

medium.sentence: The enchantment makes the pickaxe dig faster.
medium.translation: 附魔让镐子挖得更快。

hard.sentence: We put our best enchantment on the fishing rod. Now the fish practically jump into the boat by themselves.
hard.translation: 我们给鱼竿附上了最好的附魔。现在鱼儿简直自己往船上跳。

medium.sentence: The bar under the tool shows its durability.
medium.translation: 工具下面的小条显示它的耐久度。

hard.sentence: The old pickaxe has only one point of durability left. We repair it with spare metal instead of letting it break in the mine.
hard.translation: 旧镐子只剩一点耐久度了。我们用备用金属把它修好，不让它在矿井里坏掉。

medium.sentence: Put the apple into the last free slot.
medium.translation: 把苹果放进最后一个空栏位。

hard.sentence: Every slot in the chest has its own place and job. We label them with signs: food here, tools there, treasure on the top row.
hard.translation: 箱子里每个栏位都有自己的位置和任务。我们用牌子做标记：食物这边，工具那边，宝藏放最上面一排。

medium.sentence: One slot can hold an item stack of sixty-four.
medium.translation: 一个栏位能装六十四个的物品堆叠。

hard.sentence: We sort the item stacks by color and size. A neat chest saves time, especially when the whole team needs arrows fast.
hard.translation: 我们按颜色和大小整理物品堆叠。整齐的箱子省时间，特别是全队都急需箭的时候。
